138361.creator: Unknown

editorial.note: This composition is a continuation of the theme of Mary’s staying at the Temple in Jerusalem. Mary was chosen to make a veil of cochineal for the Temple in Jerusalem.

This theme is a continuation of the Annunciation. After the announcement of the Good News, Mary got to know from the archangel about pregnancy of her elderly childless cousin Elizabeth. Mary went immediately to Judaea to visit her.

editorial.note: This is a scene from the life cycle of the saint. George is a successful court commander. He was disappointed after the persecution of Christians and distributed his property among the poor.

138370.title: Abraham Meets the Three Strangers (the Old Testament Trinity)
138370.creator: Unknown

editorial.note: This is a theme of the appearance of God to Righteous Abraham. During meal Abraham and Sarah were informed about the birth of their son. Fresco depicts the moment of meeting of Forefather Abraham with messengers of God.
Prophecy came true. A son was born to Abraham and Sarah. The God decided to test the intensity of faith of his elect and ordered him to sacrifice his only son.
Saint Natalia, having learnt about the action of her husband, strongly supported him, sharing his faith and his destiny. She died on his grave, mourning him.
